sites.name: Gravel plain B

class.name: gravel
class.label: Compact gravel — good trafficability, drill testing

driving.rule: Slope within 3°, roughness within one class, same thermal class
driving.detail: Slope 0.3° here vs 0.5° at Jezero crater (tolerance 3°). Traction tests transfer. Gravity ratio 0.38: wheel load is lower on Mars. Static friction angle for gravel is about 31° on both worlds (gravity cancels); the dynamic term in the trial is where gravity shows.

landing.rule: Hazard geometry comparable; gravity 0.38× and surface pressure 0.006× Earth
landing.detail: Leg loads and tip-over geometry transfer; descent dynamics and plume–regolith interaction do not (0.6% of Earth pressure on Mars).
